description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.The ideal candidate will be responsible for the overall management of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, optimizing operational efficiency, and driving continuous improvement in quality of care. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact within a supportive organization.If you are a results-oriented LNHA with a commitment to excellence and a desire to advance your career, we encourage you to apply. Join a team dedicated to providing outstanding rehabilitation services and a high quality of life for all residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in skilled nursing facility administration
Strong leadership, operational management, and financial acumen
In-depth knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration or a related field preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
